scope: Accepted P24 production to proposed P30 only; P31/P32/P33 excluded
dataDefaults: Current Core company, currency, timezone and authorized branch; never a hard-coded business threshold
finiteRoleRequirements: Actual finite login; no schema owner/superuser/DDL/TRUNCATE/bypass role
Append-only evidence/audit/outbox has SELECT and required INSERT; no table or column UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE
Mutable domain tables and Core cases/stages/assignments only explicitly required writes
Core branch Name column SELECT declared by PO readiness; actual revoke/restore must close/reopen availability
Manual payments cannot write Finance payment statuses; no bank execution
gatesBeforeProduction: Finish actual private PO/cookie/owner and populated Down vetoes
Run separate actual RFQ, receiving and malformed-history cancellation cohorts
Protected consistent live backup and fresh isolated restore preserving all current data/owners/ACLs/default ACLs
Apply exact genuine post-P24 HRM/Procurement Up privately, capture final schema and finite permissions
Verify both actual API and HRM-only publisher startup and unchanged existing module behavior
Freeze exact paired API/publisher/UI candidate and source/file manifests
Stop both existing writers only at coordinated cutover; verify no unknown writers
Take fresh writer-stopped database/document/key/static backups and verify recovery before live Up
Apply same verified genuine Up, reconcile history/schema/data/ACL and start verified candidates with reviewed configuration
Authenticated representative UAT plus denied scopes/readiness/assets/Core/HRM smoke checks
recovery: Forward recovery after accepted new writes. Never force retained-data Down veto, discard migration history, restore over accepted writes, or infer old-image compatibility.
